Rusted Root opened

Seek Up is faded into at the very begiging (it seems a lot of late 94
shows have the same issue), and the encore break was removed.

updated and completed by Andrew Knowles on 10-28-01
 


Reconversion: Previous conversion's shn set had disc 2 tracks 8 & 9 as one track.  I split the tracks properly in cd wav editor. Remastered entire source using Soundforge 8.0.  Increased volume due to low levels. In reviewing the wav files, found a significant amount of pops, static and diginoise that were never repaired.

Fixed the following digi-errors,pops or clicks using Soundforge pencil tool:

pops at 2:04 & 2:37 of STJL fixed
pop at 2:48 of R&R fixed
dignoise at 1:41 of WWYS fixed, copied right channel to left channel, huge pops at 2:34,2:36,2:43,2:50,2:55,3:03 & 3:11 fixed
pops at 2:15,2:48,3:17 & 4:20 of Satellite fixed
pops at 0:52,1:08,1:25,& 4:08 of Billies fixed
pops at 4:58-4:59 of Minarets fixed
pops at 2:28,2:39,2:48-3:30 & 7:17-7:21 of Recently fixed
pops at 1:31,1:40,1:48,2:13,3:00,3:58,4:04,5:02 & 5:23 of Ants fixed
diginoise &/or static at 2:28,3:28,3:46 & 8:17-8:20 of AATW fixed

& Seek Up starts at beginning,not cutoff


Created flac files,fingerprints in Flac Frontend and new md5 checksums in Trader's Little Helper.
